headline: As of 2026-10-27: 35,727,343 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+10.7 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 35,727,343 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+10.7 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (5,244,505), California (3,595,843), Florida (3,515,547).
